name: codex-delegate
description: Run OpenAI Codex jobs as native background subagents (codex-delegate:implementer, reviewer, runner, rescuer, and the raw models luna, sol, astra, terra): the native task list, SendMessage, TaskStop and finish notifications, with Codex approval requests as Claude Code dialogs.

codexPath.title: Codex binary
codexPath.description: Path to the codex CLI binary (needs `codex app-server`). When this path is empty or does not exist, `codex` is looked up on PATH (on Windows: npm's @openai/codex package or a codex.exe).

nodePath.title: Node binary
nodePath.description: Node 18+ used to run the bridge process. When this path is empty or does not exist, `node` is looked up on PATH.

defaultEffort.title: Default effort
defaultEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort for every model when the prompt sets no effort: header line. per-model: each model's own default, luna max and sol, astra and terra high.

defaultSandbox.title: Default sandbox
defaultSandbox.description: Sandbox when the prompt sets no sandbox: header line.

defaultApprovals.title: Default approvals
defaultApprovals.description: auto: Codex's own reviewer decides on escalations (looser than Claude auto mode); ask: you approve each in a dialog; never: the sandbox alone decides. The full bypass, yolo, is never a user-wide default: only an explicit request or a project's .claude/codex.json sets it.

maxSandbox.title: Maximum sandbox
maxSandbox.description: Hard ceiling on the sandbox of every spawn, whatever sets it (role preset, default, project .claude/codex.json, prompt header). A spawn above it is refused, not clamped.

allowedApprovals.title: Allowed approvals
allowedApprovals.description: Comma-separated approvals values a spawn may run with, from auto, ask, never, yolo. A spawn resolving to any other is refused. yolo also needs maxSandbox full-access.

spillChars.title: Spill threshold (characters)
spillChars.description: A job's final message longer than this is written in full to .handoff/<job>.spill.md in its worktree; the answer carries its first ~1,500 characters and that path.

requireWorktree.title: Require a linked worktree for writing jobs
requireWorktree.description: When on, a spawn that may write is refused if its cwd is the main checkout rather than a linked git worktree (a non-git cwd counts as not a worktree). Read-only jobs are never refused.

maxConcurrentJobs.title: Maximum concurrent jobs
maxConcurrentJobs.description: A spawn is refused while this many Codex jobs of the session are running.
